name: mediterranean-fitness-bikini-goddess
image_purpose: show an authentic vacation moment with distinctive swimwear styling

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic daytime Mediterranean coastal travel portrait on a boat.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with wet dark hair slicked back and dark oval sunglasses. She stands on the wooden boat edge with arms raised behind her head, looking downward, one leg straight and the other bent on the gunwale. Use a relaxed confident travel pose without body-emphasis language.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical framing on the boat bow, with textured limestone cliffs, sparse shrubs, deep blue rippled ocean, distant small white boats, and a wooden railing. Keep the mismatched red-white checkerboard and pink-white-black geometric bikini as clothing pattern reference.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight, gentle shadows, realistic water droplets and coastal air, fresh sporty holiday mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail image, 35mm travel-lens look, fast shutter, realistic rock, water, skin, and fabric textures.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic full-body Mediterranean boat vacation portrait of one generic approved adult woman with wet dark hair slicked back and dark oval sunglasses, standing on the wooden boat edge with arms raised behind her head, one leg straight and one bent, mismatched red-white checkerboard and pink-black geometric bikini, limestone cliffs, deep blue ocean and distant white boats, soft diffused daylight, realistic water droplets, natural sporty travel mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, body-part emphasis, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: mediterranean-boat-portrait-reference
